name: StatusMenu Lane Probe
description: Test harness for the StatusMenu Pack lane (G3). Not a menu anyone plays with: a minimal instance of every contract surface the installer must handle - a layout with a formatter-driven text cell, a lorebookKey formatter cell (the RPG map shape), a cell naming a formatter the engine deliberately does NOT export (the warn-lane fixture), and a button bound to an action; an engine exporting two formatters and one patch-returning action; one display regex. G3 is developed end-to-end against this file and meets a builder-generated one for the first time at B1.
builtWith: hand-authored - the StatusMenu lane's own test vehicle
